      "analytical_usefulness": 0.9,
      "source_groundedness": 0.4,

      "rationale": "Directly targets the query's 'underlying causes' of longer resolution times and gives a strong grouping axis. However values assert specific resolution mechanisms (e.g. 'infrastructure_reconfiguration' for a bare 'VPN connection issue') that the short_description does not support; these are invented specifics."
    },
    {
      "name": "issue_severity_signal",
      "analytical_usefulness": 0.7,
      "source_groundedness": 0.6,
      "hallucination_observed": true,
      "rationale": "A useful axis distinct from priority for explaining duration. Some labels are defensible from text ('service_outage' for email not working), but 'intermittent' vs 'individual_access' for similar connectivity descriptions is weakly grounded and inconsistent."
    },
    {
      "name": "recurrent_issue",
      "analytical_usefulness": 0.6,
      "source_groundedness": 0.2,
      "hallucination_observed": true,
      "rationale": "Recurrence could plausibly explain resolution time, but the source text gives no basis to label a ticket recurrent; nearly all rows are 'true' with no supporting evidence in short_description, indicating fabricated inference."
    },
    {
      "name": "authentication_or_access_requirement",
      "analytical_usefulness": 0.7,
      "source_groundedness": 0.7,
      "hallucination_observed": false,
      "rationale": "Reasonable causal axis. Mostly derivable from descriptions (VPN/database access -> true; email/wifi -> false), consistent with samples."
    },
    {
      "name": "hardware_or_software_installation_need",
      "analytical_usefulness": 0.5,
      "source_groundedness": 0.7,
      "hallucination_observed": false,
      "rationale": "Plausible driver of longer times but heavily skewed (482 false) making it near-constant and low leverage. Values shown are defensible from text."
    },
    {
      "name": "scope_of_impact",
      "analytical_usefulness": 0.85,
      "source_groundedness": 0.7,
      "hallucination_observed": true,
      "rationale": "Scope is a strong candidate cause for duration. Department cases are well grounded, but 'company_wide' being the dominant value and 'single_user' assigned to a plain 'VPN connection issue' involve inference beyond what many terse descriptions state."
    },
    {
      "name": "assigned_technician",
      "analytical_usefulness": 0.3,
      "source_groundedness": 0.5,
      "hallucination_observed": false,
      "rationale": "Largely redundant with existing 'assigned_to' original column, adding little new leverage. Values are plausible but not verifiable from the provided short_description text."
    },
    {
      "name": "assigned_resolver_consistency",
      "analytical_usefulness": 0.4,
      "source_groundedness": 0.6,
      "hallucination_observed": false,
      "rationale": "Whether opener/resolver match could relate to handoff delays, giving some leverage, but it is derived from other columns rather than text and is somewhat generic."
    },
    {
      "name": "closure_status_completeness",
      "analytical_usefulness": 0.2,
      "source_groundedness": 0.6,
      "hallucination_observed": false,
      "rationale": "A near-boolean completeness flag largely restating closure fields; little analytical leverage for explaining duration causes."
    },
    {
      "name": "issue_category",
      "analytical_usefulness": 0.5,
      "source_groundedness": 0.85,
      "hallucination_observed": false,
      "rationale": "Well grounded categorisation of the short_description (email/vpn/database/network). Useful, but the query says to control for category, so it partly overlaps the original 'category' column, reducing marginal leverage."
    }
  ],
  "analytical_usefulness": 0.6,
  "source_groundedness": 0.58,
  "rationale": "Several columns (resolution_complexity, scope_of_impact, authentication_requirement, issue_severity_signal) give genuine new axes to explain longer resolution times beyond priority and category, which is exactly what the query needs. Weaknesses: some columns are redundant with originals (assigned_technician vs assigned_to, issue_category vs category) or near-constant/restated (closure_status_completeness). Groundedness is mixed: categorisation-style columns read the description soundly, but 'resolution_complexity' and especially 'recurrent_issue' assert confident specifics (mechanisms, recurrence) that the terse source text does not support, indicating hallucinated inference."
}
